regime_context: The TSX detector shows a broad eligible universe (14/16 themes) with Base Metals & Copper as the clear leader (rank 1, uncrowded, high breadth). The absolute trend gate is validated for risk control; momentum is a focus lens, not alpha. Gold Miners exhibit high durability and a trend regime. Crowding is absent except in Technology and Insurers.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: The theme holds top momentum rank, broad participation, and the absolute trend gate supports staying power, reducing extreme drawdown risk.
theses.dissent: Commodity cycles can reverse sharply on global slowdown; the trend gate does not prevent all losses and offers no return edge.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX Composite by 5% between now and 2026-09-06.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners display high durability (0.79) and a persistent trend regime, with broad participation and no crowding; the trend gate is supportive of staying with the trend.
theses.dissent: Gold may be vulnerable to rising real rates or a risk-on rotation; a mean-reversion could be sharp despite the trend tag.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO closes below its 21-day moving average for five consecutive days before 2026-09-06.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks are eligible, not crowded, and show reasonable durability (0.67); the trend gate helps manage downside while the theme holds strong relative rank.
theses.dissent: Financials are sensitive to credit cycle and net interest margins; a reversal in rate-cut expectations could hurt performance.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO closes below its 50-day moving average for three consecutive days before 2026-08-28.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
